interpretation.benefit: Frozen guarded hybrid recovers 17/18 burst pairs versus 11/18 unchanged baseline-predicate pairs with zero observed cross-scene joins on this small corpus.
interpretation.limits: Assistant-reviewed size-biased 18-burst raw-rendered corpus does not establish population false-group risk, family/pet/action coverage, or physical-device readiness.
interpretation.mainThreadRisk: Inference is synchronous on the main thread. Measured individual inference durations exceed interactive-frame budgets, especially under synthetic CPU throttling. Do not ship this harness adapter as an opt-in product feature.
interpretation.longTaskCaution: Observed Long Task API entries do not capture every synchronous inference continuation in this run. They are incomplete observations, not a worst-case UI-blocking bound. Use the recorded synchronous inference durations when discussing this risk.
interpretation.nextImplementationGate: Design an isolated worker-based or genuinely interruptible inference prototype with cancellation and state-preservation tests before considering product integration; retain physical-device and broader independent-label gates.
